feature_main_detail: Messages go to the main chat (/new, /list to switch), and replies come back to Lark
feature_cards_detail: When Persona or an agent you drive from Lark needs an answer or approval, it sends a card in Lark. One tap does it.
feature_all_cards_detail: Questions and approvals from every agent on all your computers go to Lark
feature_pushes_detail: Persona's notifications and scheduled task results also go to Lark
feature_sync_detail: Replies in the main chat from the app or scheduled tasks also go to Lark
feature_reports_detail: When tasks from the main chat finish, wait for you or get cut off, one card sums them up in Lark, with stages and links
feature_board_detail: /tasks sends one card listing everything waiting for you, then keeps it up to date in place instead of sending a new one
feature_workbench_detail: /home brings up a pinned home card of everything going on (kept the only one and up to date), every card gets a button back to it, /today and /inbox show the day and the Inbox, and /start asks for a permission mode
feature_only_conclusions_detail: Tasks from the main chat no longer send their progress (a finished turn, waiting for you, interrupted), which stays in the to-do list and the briefing; a conclusion card still comes when there is one: done, can't be done, or needs your decision
feature_report_steps_detail: By default a task is pushed only when its goal changes: reached, needs your decision, or stuck. Turn this on for the old card: every agent's finished turn (with the stage bar and what the agent said), interruptions and closings too
feature_agents_detail: Use /agents to pick Claude Code or Codex on any of your computers and chat with it in Lark; /start begins a new one
step_create_app: On the Lark Developer Console, create a custom app and turn on the Bot feature
step_permissions: Under permissions, turn on: read and send direct messages (im:message, im:message:send_as_bot); receive direct messages sent to the bot; upload and download images, files and other attachments in messages. Reading contact names is also worth turning on (contact:user.base:readonly)
step_events: Under Events & callbacks, choose to receive events through a persistent connection, and subscribe to Message received and Card action
step_publish: Publish a version (your company's admin may need to approve it), then enter the App ID and App Secret above
title: Lark bot
footer: Messaging this bot in Lark is talking to Persona. It only answers you once paired, and stays quiet in groups.
larkcli_dialog_footer: Uses your Lark account to bring @mentions, direct chats and document comments into the Inbox.
test_sent: Sent a test message to Lark
credentials_from_config: The credentials in manager.json are in use; saving here switches to these.
credentials_secret_note: The App Secret is stored encrypted on the hub and won't be shown again.
pair_hint: Click Pair to get a 6-digit code, then send it to the bot in Lark within 10 minutes.
pair_enable_first: Turn on the Lark bot before pairing.
unpair_confirm: Unpair? The bot will stop answering this Lark account until you pair again.
pair_code_prompt: Send this code to the bot in Lark
features_footer: The main chat can use all your data (Lark, mail, your phone's calendar and location…), and what the bot sends stays in Lark. Anything done on your behalf still asks you first.
howto_footer: The hub opens the persistent connection itself, so it doesn't need a public address.
nudge_detail: A card still unanswered after this long gets one reply under it in Lark (in a group topic it mentions you), outside your quiet hours
combined_footer: One Lark app: talk to Persona through the bot, and collect what mentions you into the Inbox with “Collect my Lark messages”.
credentials_shared_note: The bot and “Collect my Lark messages” share this app.
read_more_hint: Choose what to collect into the Inbox
read_off_footer: Off: @mentions and your direct chats are no longer collected; the sign-in and what was collected stay.
